info.title: Classes Session-note Evidence
info.description: Source candidate contract, additive legacy fields. Site primary SMTP acceptance is not inbox delivery. Empty or unknown evidence is not overdue mail. Mac consuming-app adoption and protected-copy host rehearsal remain separate gates.

get.description: Read-only, bounded metadata. Exactly one student filter; inclusive range max 366 days. Every page preserves coverage. No mailbox or booking inference.

202.description: Pending, ambiguous or tracking reconciliation; do not blindly resend

post.summary: Audit and clear a writer whose old process is confirmed stopped
post.description: Sending and recovery must both be paused. Active writers cannot be cleared. Persistent markers never expire automatically. Verify the previous API process is stopped; use protected evidence and a stable key. No email is sent.

ReadOnlyBearer.description: Existing verification-only token; no mutation permissions

AdministratorSession.name: __Host-session
AdministratorSession.description: Current signed administrator session. Writes require approved Origin/Referer; cookie/signature names follow server session configuration.

EvidenceRegistration.description: Metadata only, 16 KiB maximum. Timestamp cannot exceed server time by over one minute. Machine scope permits only mac_sent_item observations for allowlisted students and forbids corrections. Session and optional note must belong to student. No nearest-date inference. Digest references are protected local references, not raw transport IDs.

Operation.description: Accepted-but-unrecorded response intentionally omits unavailable timestamps/version/archive fields. Keep operationId; 202 is pending or reconciliation, not permission to retry with a new key.

SessionNoteSend.description: The session-note form of existing /admin-mail/send. At most 20 recipients; to is comma-separated, first is primary. Saved note/version must match content, recipient and verified session snapshot. Other mail without sessionDate has no session-note evidence. Reuse identical key/payload after lost responses.

Disposition.description: Explicit audited retry queues only an existing rejected/proven-nonaccepted intent, capped at 20 attempts. Ambiguous outcomes require a separate finding of nonacceptance; no SMTP timestamp is fabricated. Archival dispositions require both sending and recovery paused and review_required on an accepted/rejected operation. Confirmed absence queues only archival repair, capped at five attempts; present marks the archive complete. SMTP state and timestamps remain unchanged. All decisions are idempotent and audited against an opaque protected-evidence reference.
